THE PROBLEM

Why it matters

A store front end cannot be trusted with prices or stock. Anyone can edit a request.

HOW IT WAS BUILT

Approach

The browser stores only item IDs and quantities. The Node API looks up real prices, checks stock and calculates totals. Shared validation runs on both sides.

Key features

  • 01Debounced search, filters and sorting
  • 02Stock limits enforced on the server
  • 03Promo codes and free-shipping rules
  • 04Checkout with field-level validation
